## Behavior and scope

Describe the exact changed behavior, linked work item, specification sections and
supported capability boundary. Explain why the result is a complete reviewable slice.

## Evidence

Record commands, environment, corpus/tool revisions, results and artifact locations.
For implementation changes, include meaningful negative and boundary-case coverage.
Report every known failure, exclusion and limitation without counting it as a pass.

## Review considerations

Explain affected trust boundaries, ownership/lifetime rules, dependencies and release
gates. Update the capability matrix and plan when scope or acceptance changes.
